data.scope: The authorized four-Short narration capture batch only. No avatar, lip-sync, music, render, release or publication state changes.
data.method: Immutable provider intent and receipt, WAV probe with the pinned tail-energy rule, followed by local HyperFrames Whisper diagnostic transcription; no provider retry.
data.finding: The first Short 1 Algieba guide returned HTTP 200 but measured tail energy 0.0357, above the pinned 0.02 guide-completeness threshold.
data.diagnostic: Local Whisper recognized 97 words and the complete closing sentence. Its only lexical difference was the acoustically identical write/right homophone; ASR cannot prove the final phoneme was not clipped.
data.execution_state: One Google guide call, zero retries, zero later guide calls and zero ElevenLabs transfers. Estimated Google cost is 0.0197845 USD.
data.policy_result: The no-retry authorization stopped the batch. Fresh owner authority is required before any additional provider call or acceptance of the marginal guide.
data.limitations: The local ASR diagnostic establishes that the closing sentence was recognized, but it cannot establish an unclipped final phoneme or replace owner listening. No claim is made about Shorts 2 through 4 because their provider calls were not submitted.
data.recommended_next_action: Authorize one replacement Short 1 Google guide attempt; do not transfer the marginal guide without listening to its ending.
